caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair is rendered in shades of dark brown, emphasizing its wooden texture. It features two horizontal back slats that are slightly curved, with each vertical post ending in a finial at the top. The seat of the chair is a lighter brown, suggesting either woven material or wood, and there are rounded spindle details beneath the seat. The legs of the chair are straight with crossbars connecting them, forming a simple, sturdy structure. The artist's signature, "Cordena Jackson," is present at the bottom right within the frame of the artwork. The composition centers the chair within a rectangular outlined border, and there are no additional objects or embellishments in the drawing.
title: Child's Chair
